title: matelea suberosa
intro: Matelea suberosa, commonly known as the "Coral Honeysuckle," is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, exhibiting health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to the alleviation of pain, fever, and infections. The therapeutic actions of Matelea suberosa include analgesic, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
